states.when: Before a request has been executed in the selected tab
states.title: Ready to send
states.description: Send a request to inspect the response.

states.when: No request is currently open; user is prompted to create one
states.title: Create a request
states.description: Create a request to start working with your API.

states.title: No activity
states.description: Run a request to see activity here.

states.when: Response completed but has no body (for example HTTP 204)
states.title: No response body
states.description: The request completed without a response body.

states.when: Service is unavailable (gRPC UNAVAILABLE / HTTP 503), not a specific DNS or TLS error
states.title: Service unavailable

states.when: TCP connection refused or target port unreachable
states.title: Connection failed
states.description: Could not connect to the target service.

states.title: DNS error
states.description: Check the server hostname and DNS configuration.

states.when: TLS handshake, certificate, or trust validation failure
states.title: TLS error
states.description: A secure connection could not be established.

states.when: Deadline exceeded or request timed out
states.title: Request timed out
states.description: The request took too long to complete.

states.when: No collections exist in the active workspace
states.title: No collections
states.description: Create a collection to organize your requests.

states.when: A data-driven view has no records
states.title: No data
states.description: There is no data to display here.

states.when: Selected collection folder contains no requests or child items
states.title: Empty folder
states.description: This folder does not contain any requests yet.

states.when: Request completed successfully and success feedback is appropriate; do not replace an actual response body
states.title: Request completed
